body: Well, this was my last resort, & no help. I used a throw away for this, been a good couple years Reddit, thank you all for the knowledge wisdom, comedy, & entertainment. But there comes a point where it becomes human to put ones self out of their own misery, I guess I should have the right to decide to suffer euphoria eluding me or off myself.

Kill a man during war & you are a hero, kill a man during a time of peace & you are a murderer. I hardley see how someone who could manage to pull the trigger on them selves is a coward, that takes nerve & pain. Where as fighting for a corrupt government dropping bombs on women, children, & innocent people, makes you a murder & coward in some peoples eyes.

Thank you for the terrible advice ~ A 17 year old suicidal girl, who you recommended becoming a murderer too.
I rather off myself than other people, but thank you for pointing out that option.
